title: Mikasa's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Night Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, the pick, the canon, or re-roll.

options.label: The Night Ledger
options.lineage: double-entry ledger books and feint-ruled account paper
options.thesis: The course is a keeper's ledger on a dark desk at night: ruled entries, dated progress, a red margin line. It refuses the floating-cards dashboard every learning app ships.
materials: feint-ruled paper on a dark desk
options.viewport: Left rail lists Modules as the ledger's account heads. The page is one ruled sheet: numbered Lesson entries with one-line summaries, minutes in tabular figures at the right edge. A single band above the rules names the next entry. The Tutor annotates in a narrow margin column; the Tailor proposes changes as correction slips laid over the page.
options.risk: Reads bookkeeper-dry if rules and stamps are decoration instead of structure; the grammar must do real work.

raised.raise: The text field stays achromatic; state color lives only in rules, stamps, and edge marks, never in the prose.
One message per band: a persistent next-up band carries the single next entry and its minutes, nothing else.
A strict accent law: posting red is reserved for exactly one meaning, the next entry and the margin line, never decoration.
Entry numerals set oversized and confident, livery-scale, as wayfinding inside the page.

options.signature: Marking an Exercise done stamps the entry with an inked ENTERED mark that settles slightly rotated; the module subtotal rolls to recount in tabular figures.

options.label: The Study Lamp
options.lineage: the night desk under a single task lamp
options.thesis: One warm light in a dark room. The active lesson lives in the pool of light; everything not in use recedes into shadow. Chrome almost disappears.
options.viewport: The workspace sits in near-dark; the current Lesson panel is the lit pool at reading scale, module rail and tutor dimmed at the pool's edge until hovered.
options.risk: It is the dark-mode-with-warm-accent many thoughtful products land on, and dimmed-by-default chrome risks low-contrast accessibility traps.
options.case: My top-ranked grounded candidate before the roll; assigned beat it into second on the same two axes.

options.label: The Safelight Bay
options.lineage: photographic printing darkrooms under amber safelight
options.thesis: Course generation as development chemistry: the Outline is the exposure, each Lesson emerges like a print in the tray, deliberate and timed.
options.viewport: The workspace glows amber on near-black; the lesson you are reading is the print developing, text emerging from gray ghost.
options.case: Fuses well onto the two-phase generation, and amber suits the evening scene. Holds audience identification but loses clarity: its irreversible chemistry contradicts the product's per-change undo and mutable courses, the one thing ADR 0001 pins.
options.risk: Total amber wash fights the calm-polished register and tires over long reading sessions.

options.label: Terminal Signs
options.lineage: international airport sign systems, Schiphol yellow
options.thesis: Learning as a signed route: every screen shows only the next decision, with the destination and the minutes it will take.
options.viewport: A yellow band hangs over the workspace: the next Lesson, left arrow, twelve minutes. Corridor scrolled past, the band stays.
options.case: Unbeatable task clarity and everyone knows the grammar. Holds product clarity outright, loses audience identification: terminal urgency is the opposite of an evening desk.
options.risk: High-alert energy in every surface; hard to make calm without breaking the system.

options.label: Cloud Edge Spectra
options.case: Fuses poorly: pastel iridescence reads decorative in a work surface and has no answer for progress or structure.
options.kept: Color banished from the text field; state color only at hairline edges.

options.label: Miura Deployable
options.case: Fuses partially: the folding sheet mirrors outline-then-deploy, but tessellated panels fight long-form reading.
options.kept: Linked propagation: one change visibly moves everything creased to it.

options.label: Arcade Phosphor
options.lineage: CRT arcade cabinets and sprite palettes
options.case: Fuses badly: phosphor glow and arcade energy sit against the brief's explicit no-gamification line.
options.kept: Palette law: accents rationed by rule, states addressable in code.

options.label: Racing League
options.case: Fuses badly: velocity grammar needs momentum the product does not have; learning pace is the learner's.
options.kept: Numerals with conviction: numbers at livery scale, confident and unapologetic.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every focused learning tool ships: clean neutral surface, workhorse sans, one blue accent, card dashboard. Executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar with course list, content cards on a neutral ground, primary button in accent blue.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design; that is the point of the canon.
canonCard.case: Played straight, at full craft, if you want Mikasa to sit alongside Linear and Notion with no argument.
